// Package handler covers every Go declaration kind and import form.
package handler

import "fmt"

import (
	"context"
	_ "embed"
	. "math"
	stdstrings "strings"

	"example.com/corpus"
	"example.com/corpus/go/repository"
	repo2 "example.com/corpus/go/repository"
	"github.com/acme/ext/v2"
)

// UserHandler is a struct with a pointer-receiver and a value-receiver method.
type UserHandler struct {
	repo *repository.Repo
}

type (
	// Store is an interface inside a grouped type declaration.
	Store interface {
		Get(ctx context.Context, id int) (string, error)
	}
	ID      int
	Alias   = string
	List[T any] []T
	private struct{}
)

func NewUserHandler() *UserHandler { return &UserHandler{} }

func (h *UserHandler) Get(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner := func() {}
	inner()
	return nil
}

func (h UserHandler) name() string { return stdstrings.ToUpper(fmt.Sprint(Pi)) }

func Map[T, U any](xs []T, f func(T) U) []U { return nil }

func init() {}

const Version = "1"

var Default = NewUserHandler()

var (
	_ = repo2.Find
	_ = corpus.X
	_ = ext.Y
)

// multi-byte text before a declaration on the same line (UTF-16 column)
var _ = "日本語😀"; func Late() {}
